about: TAMCON Software Solutions PLC builds the mission-critical software powering Ethiopia's digital transformation. Founded in 2024 from a partnership between Tamesol Communications and Convex ICT Technologies, TAMCON engineers secure, highly scalable enterprise and fintech platforms capable of handling massive daily transaction volumes. The company's flagship project, digitizing the Ethiopian Lottery Service, onboarded over 3.5 million registered users within a year of launch. TAMCON specializes in fintech and payment integrations, scalable cloud infrastructure, omnichannel (web + POS hardware) deployments, and inclusive, multilingual user experiences for the public and financial sectors.

mission: We turn national digitization strategies into reliable operational realities. Day-to-day, we engineer, deploy, and maintain battle-tested enterprise and fintech platforms capable of handling massive transactional volume, bridging the gap between high-level policy and real-world execution for public and financial institutions.

history: TAMCON Software Solutions PLC was founded on a vision to bring global technological best practices to Ethiopia while solving on-the-ground challenges of the local market. The company originated from a strategic partnership between Tamesol Communications (an established Ethiopian company known for pioneering digital solutions and large-scale campaigns) and Convex ICT Technologies (a global provider of scalable, secure cloud and fintech infrastructure serving over 85 operators worldwide). TAMCON's first major undertaking was modernizing the Ethiopian Lottery Service, transforming a paper-based operation into a secure, transparent, fully-featured web-based platform supporting 8 major Ethiopian languages and integrating with Ethiopia's digital payment infrastructure, including TeleBirr. Within 6 months of launch, the platform acquired over 3,500,000 registered users, the fastest adoption of its kind in the country's sector. Today, TAMCON operates from its expanded footprint in the Bedesta Building with dedicated units in Software Engineering, UI/UX, Security, and Systems Integration.
